framing.lineOfInquiry: Karan Grewal (P00057) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE031
framing.alternate: Karan Grewal (P00057) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: The location records are unreliable
alternateHypotheses.statement: Karan Grewal's location records are imprecise or inconsistent (tower-level accuracy, cloned or shared SIM), so they do not reliably place them at the scene.
alternateHypotheses.label: Strong

evidence.text: The record placing them near the scene (CDR) is only accurate to about 1.5 km

alternateHypotheses.title: The money has a legitimate explanation
alternateHypotheses.statement: The flagged money movements of Karan Grewal have an ordinary purpose (salary, rent, property, business) or belong to a co-holder of the account.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

alternateHypotheses.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
alternateHypotheses.statement: Karan Grewal was near the scene because they regularly go there (home, work, market), not because of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

confidence.note: Evidential balance compares weighted supporting vs contradicting evidence; it is not a probability of guilt. Prior records are excluded from this score.

note: Each hypothesis is tested from both sides to reduce confirmation bias. Confidence scores are evidential balance (not probability of guilt). Human review is required.
